item.title: City Of Warsaw Temporarily Relocates Public Meetings
item.description: All city of Warsaw public meetings will temporarily move to the Warsaw Police Department Training Center, 2225 E. Fort Wayne St., beginning Monday, Feb. 2, according to a news release from the city.
